join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!filter banphrase
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!filter banphrase
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter banphrase on|off|add|delete|clear|list

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter banphrase on|off|add|delete|clear|list

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send



handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase filter is already enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase filter is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase filter is already disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase filter is now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are 0 banned phrases.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase delete what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase not found.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase add REGEX:what's.*up
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Only admins may add regex banned words.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase add runescape
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase added.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There is 1 banned phrase.

twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "7f18cc2a-5148-4aa6-98fd-d8828fe14e26"}
handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=7f18cc2a-5148-4aa6-98fd-d8828fe14e26 chatter-display=Random :RuneScape is cool
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, disallowed word or phrase - warning


clock_forward 3h

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!filter banphrase add REGEX:\d\d\d
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase added.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are 2 banned phrases.

twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "ed7e8a24-df5a-4842-b6a1-22871c5af6e9"}
handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=ed7e8a24-df5a-4842-b6a1-22871c5af6e9 chatter-display=Random :1234
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, disallowed word or phrase - warning


clock_forward 3h

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!filter banphrase remove runescape
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase removed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There is 1 banned phrase.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :RuneScape is cool
no_send


clock_forward 3h

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!filter banphrase add hello there
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrase added.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are 2 banned phrases.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter banphrase clear
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Banned phrases have been cleared.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :12345
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :hello there
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!filter banphrase add REGEX:
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Error parsing pattern: empty pattern

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!filter banphrase add REGEX:(
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Error parsing pattern: missing closing )
